title: Annotatio V §.II cont open: True divine Fundamentals make the limits — proved Autoritative and Ratiocinative
pass_a_gloss: But that the same true and divine Fundamentals make the limits of Ecclesiastical Consociation is proved both Autoritatively and Ratiocinatively.
pass_b_english: That the same true, divine Fundamentals set the limits of church Consociation is proved two ways — by authority and by reason.
source_text: Eadem verò Fundamentalia vera divinaque, Consociationis Ecclesiasticae limites conficere, probatur, tàm Autoritative, quam Ratiocinative.
